newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Bangladesh PM Hasina retains her party position.
newsitem.headline: Bangladesh PM Hasina retains her party position.

text.p: Bangladesh Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina on Wednesday was re-elected president of her centrist Awami League party for a fourth term, party officials said.
Hasina faced no opponents in her bid for the party leadership, which she has held since 1981, the officials said.
Hasina was cheered by thousands of delegates after being declared the party's president at the end of a two-day convention, witnesses said.
Officials said she could now appoint new members to the party's central executive committee, including the vital post of secretary general.
Hasina steered her Awami League to power for a second time in 21 years during last year's June elections.
The Awami League, which led the country's liberation movement in 1971, lost power when the country's founding leader and Hasina's father Sheikh Mujibur Rahman was killed in a 1975 military coup.
